definition: the one utility below C, and what its shape has to do with that

settled:
Nothing Dominion has done in particular put it at D. Its shape did.

It is publicly traded, so the profit pressure comes with the form. It is a regulated monopoly, and one of those sits inside a captured relationship with its regulator by default. Its supply side is the fossil fuel trade.

Of our three billing relationships for the house it is the only one below C, and the only one that lives entirely in a private corporate structure. The contrast tells me something.

Heating and hot water rest on it as things are now. Gas cooking would be the residue even after a heat pump.

title: Why The Gas Company Is The Worst Of Them
